claims.text: StrategyQA is a question answering benchmark where required reasoning steps are implicit in the question.
StrategyQA contains 2,780 examples, each consisting of a strategy question, its decomposition, and evidence paragraphs.
Humans achieve an accuracy of 87% on the StrategyQA benchmark.
The best baseline model achieves an accuracy of approximately 66% on the StrategyQA benchmark.

evidence.description: Empirically, humans perform well (87%) on the StrategyQA task.
The best baseline model reaches an accuracy of ~ 66% on StrategyQA.

methodologies.name: StrategyQA Data Collection and Annotation Pipeline
methodologies.description: A crowd-sourcing procedure combining term-based priming, annotator population control, and adversarial filtering with question decomposition and Wikipedia paragraph retrieval annotations.

limitations.text: Current datasets for multi-hop reasoning explicitly mention the required answering steps in the question.
